notes: A new home page, Environment Overview: every launch opens on entry cards for agents, session data, the API service, proxy, disk cleanup and the key vault, each with live numbers and its main action.
The checkup score is gone: the page checks by itself and only speaks up when something needs attention, with fixes and AI diagnosis right there.
Programming ecosystems show version, version manager, download source, state and pending updates in one panel.

A failed install or update can be handed to your own coding agent in a terminal with the failure explained; WinGet and the official installer stand in for each other, and WinINet is one click away when WinGet downloads crawl.
AI now reads backups, Git failures, the app log and session footprint items.
The window appears only once its first screen is drawn, the vault's unlock wait counts down, recovery keys can be saved to a file, and Settings lists where Stacker keeps everything.
Stacker now ships as the setup installer only; portable packages ended with v0.3.4.
